svg.aria-label: The manuscript mode of the researcher skill. Boxes: The record of the experiments, when the project holds none (stop); You confirm the run's configuration and its budget (stop); /paper full: the draft, Stage 2 (a run of another skill); The checkpoint after Stage 2 (stop); Integrity agent, Stage 2.5: the sampled depth, the ethics check last (agent); Compliance agent, Stage 2.5 (agent); A failure-mode block, a compliance block, or a BLOCKED or CONDITIONAL ethics verdict (stop); A FAIL: the correction list to confirm (stop); /paper revision: the correction round (a run of another skill); The third correction round failed: you decide (stop); The checkpoint after Stage 2.5 (stop); /paper-review-panel full: the review, Stage 3 (a run of another skill); The review decision (stop); /paper revision: the revision, Stage 4 (a run of another skill); An incomplete revision: each item left, with its reason (stop); The checkpoint after Stage 4 (stop); /paper-review-panel re-review: the re-review, Stage 3' (a run of another skill); A regression, or the early-stopping suggestion, from the score deltas (stop); The re-review decision (stop); /paper revision: the minor items of a Minor decision, once (a run of another skill); /paper revision: the re-revision, Stage 4', once (a run of another skill); The checkpoint after Stage 4' (stop); A fresh integrity agent, Stage 4.5: the full depth, the ethics check last (agent); Compliance agent, Stage 4.5 (agent); A failure-mode block, a compliance block, or a BLOCKED or CONDITIONAL ethics verdict (stop); A FAIL: the correction list to confirm (stop); /paper revision: the correction round (a run of another skill); The third correction round failed: you decide (stop); The checkpoint after Stage 4.5 (stop); The entry point: the line of Quick start a call without a mode matches (stop); An unfinished run: continue it or start a new one (stop); A run that fails: retry it or pause it (stop); The parsed comments, with a comments file (stop); The strategic coaching, with a comments file, at most 8 rounds (stop); The checkpoint after the completeness check, with a comments file (stop).

svg.text: integrity runs one check alone: the integrity agent at the full depth, or with pre-review at the sampled depth, then the compliance agent, the same blocks and at most 3 correction rounds through /paper revision, and the run ends. A draft

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: given to manuscript enters at Stage 2.5. With a comments file it goes from Stage 2.5 to Stage 4 with the comments, then to the session's completeness check in place of the re-review, a stop, and to Stage 4.5. Each run of paper and

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: paper-review-panel is invoked through the Skill tool with its own stops, which are not drawn. The session holds every checkpoint and writes the run's state and the Material Passport. Each integrity record and each compliance report is a file

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the run folder. novelty, idea and readme start no agent and are not drawn: novelty searches the closest prior work on each claim of an idea, confirms each work it cites with lookup.py resolve and writes a page with a verdict per claim,

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: idea puts the choices of the idea to you in rounds of the interview, runs novelty between them and writes the research questions and claims into the README, and readme drafts the project's README and code README for a newcomer and writes

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: them after you approve the drafts.
